title: Checkout, Tax & Payment Gateway Modernization
description: Modernize the E-Automate shopping cart, order placement, sales tax computation, and mock payment gateway integration.

title: Sales Tax (10%) and Free Shipping on Order Placement
description: As a customer, when I purchase items, a flat 10% sales tax should be added to the subtotal and shipping should be free ($0.00).
acceptance_criteria:
1. Subtotal = sum(unitPrice * quantity).
2. Tax = round(subtotal * 0.10, 2).
3. Total = round(subtotal * 1.10, 2).
4. Any total less than subtotal is a critical regression in OrderController.

title: Atomic Inventory Stock Decrement & Cancellation Restoration
description: As an inventory manager, when an order is placed, stock must decrement atomically. If an admin cancels the order, stock must be returned.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Requesting quantity > stock returns HTTP 409 Conflict.
2. Stock decrements immediately upon successful checkout.
3. Transitioning order status to 'cancelled' restores product stock.

title: Mock Payment Gateway Card Decline Rules
description: As a QA automation engineer, I need deterministic test cards so I can test success (4242) and decline (0002) flows.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Cards ending in 4242 return HTTP 201 Created.
2. Cards ending in 0002 return HTTP 402 Payment Required with 'Payment declined by issuer (card ending in 0002)'.
3. This is working as designed for test automation.

title: User Authentication & Shopping Cart Persistence
description: Enterprise JWT authentication, RBAC authorization, and guest-to-authenticated cart synchronization.

title: Guest Cart Merge on Login via /api/cart/sync
description: As a shopper, if I add items to my cart as a guest and then sign in, my items should automatically merge into my database cart.
acceptance_criteria:
1. POST /api/cart/sync merges guest items.
2. Duplicate product entries merge quantities.
3. Quantity capped at available product stock.

title: Optional Address Line 2 in Shipping Form
description: As a customer living in a single-family house, Address Line 2 (Apartment/Suite) must be strictly optional.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Omitting line2 must not throw HTTP 500 NullPointerException.
2. Line 1, City, State, ZIP, and Country remain required.

title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) on Admin APIs
description: As a system administrator, customer accounts (ROLE_USER) must be prohibited from calling /api/admin/* endpoints.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Standard customer calling /api/admin/* returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.
2. Unauthenticated request returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
3. Admin token returns HTTP 200 OK.

title: Checkout total calculates 0.99x instead of 1.10x tax multiplier
description: When BUG_OFF_BY_ONE_DISCOUNT is active, total is discounted instead of taxed.
reproduction_steps:
1. Log in as buyer.
2. Add prod_001 ($450.00).
3. Complete checkout.
4. Observe total is $445.50 instead of $495.00.
triage_notes: [Triage Note]: Root cause identified in OrderController.java line 148. BUG_OFF_BY_ONE_DISCOUNT disabled.
